Major divergence present: multiple large-cap and sector leaders show 1W gains with 1M losses (LRCX, AMAT, WFC) — tactical moves, watch for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**8. Financials Outlook?**

Healthcare showing strain with isolated strength: JNJ (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -4.17%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -2.30% | 1M: -4.21%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND, while PFE (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +0.41%) ABOVE TREND is a lone positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Under RISK-OFF favor Energy and select Financials—XOM (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +5.76%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +2.49% | 1M: +9.17%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND—reduce exposure to large-cap Tech names showing broad weakness such as AAPL (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -4.83%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.46% | 1M: -4.17%) BELOW TREND; style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth.

BULLISH: OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +5.76%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +0.41%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NEM (1W: -12.58% | 1M: -23.45%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -16.51%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA (1W: -4.06% | 1M: -7.96%) BELOW TREND for failure below the recent 1W support to signal deeper tech weakness; AAPL (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -4.83%) BELOW TREND reclaim of the 1M range would be required to shift momentum; JPM (1W: +1.10% | 1M: -6.98%) RECOVERY needs sustained weekly follow-through to confirm financials-led stabilization.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**

BA (-45): reduced role headline and price BA (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -16.51%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. ## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, Value/Cyclical style. XOM (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +5.76%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +2.49% | 1M: +9.17%) ABOVE TREND and OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: concentrated downside across mega-cap Tech (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA BELOW TREND) and several names (LLY, TSLA) where bullish headlines are not yet reflected in price — watch for trend breaks.
